bio_en: Gergely Ujhelyi is Associate Professor of Economics at the University of Houston. His research is in political economy and the economics of public administration — bureaucracy, civil service reforms, and political machines — with publications in outlets including the American Economic Journal: Economic Policy and the Journal of Public Economics. Gergely Ujhelyi has published in journals like Journal of the European Economic Association, American Economic Review and Journal of Public Economics.
bio_hu: Ujhelyi Gergely a University of Houston közgazdász docense. Kutatási területe a politikai gazdaságtan és a bürokrácia közgazdaságtana — közszolgálati reformok, politikai gépezetek és a közszféra termelékenysége —,. Ujhelyi Gergely tanulmányai olyan folyóiratokban jelentek meg, mint a Journal of the European Economic Association, az American Economic Review és a Journal of Public Economics.
